release_notes: The TikTok MCP consent screen no longer refuses to authorize: the tracker now sends the MCP server address (the RFC 8707 "resource" parameter) in the login URL and in both token requests, exactly as TikTok's MCP authorization requires. If you were stuck at the TikTok login screen, update and press "Connect via TikTok MCP" again — and if anything fails after Authorize, send us the error text.
